title: Structure map — L2 projection catalogue + lineage manifest (S4.4, s4_plan D-S4-E/D-S4-J)
description: Tier-1 shape validation only: field presence, types, container-xor-leaf (oneOf), and no extra keys (additionalProperties:false throughout). Everything JSON Schema cannot say — ownership, coverage, reference integrity, alias uniqueness, vocab hygiene — is Tier-2 (validate_structure_map). node_class is deliberately an OPEN string (no enum): the block vocabulary is per-book data declared in this document's own block_vocabulary header, never a schema constant (inv 22). The schema_version const is bound to the live STRUCTURE_MAP_SCHEMA_VERSION by schema_version_const() + the version-derived conforming fixture (inv 10), never a free-floating literal.

schema_version.description: The structure-map document schema version. Bound to STRUCTURE_MAP_SCHEMA_VERSION via schema_version_const() (inv 10) — a bump here without the Python constant (or vice versa) fails the binding test.

root_id.description: The node_id of the single root container (s4_plan §3.B.0). Resolution is Tier-2a (ROOT_ID_DANGLING).

map_revision.description: Monotonic authoring clock (s4_plan §3.D.5): alias valid_from/valid_to reference it; the writer increments it once per authoring change.

block_vocabulary.description: The per-book open node_class vocabulary (s4_plan §3.B.2/§3.E.7). Hygiene (normalization, duplicates, unknown-collision, unused) is Tier-2 (VOCAB_*).

handle_policies.description: node_class → default handle policy (s4_plan §3.D.1). Key membership in block_vocabulary and policy resolvability are Tier-2 (POLICY_NOT_IN_VOCAB / POLICY_UNRESOLVED).

furniture_atoms.description: Captured-but-excluded atoms (witness ids, s4_plan §3.B.1) with their capture_role — the fourth ownership bucket; never inside a node slot.

aliases.description: Hand-authored retired-handle records (s4_plan §3.D.4/§3.D.5). Uniqueness, target liveness, and the temporal rules are Tier-2 (ALIAS_*).

nodes.description: Flat node table (s4_plan §3.B.4): children-only edges, parent derived on load. May be empty at Tier-1 — the empty map is rejected semantically (ROOT_ID_DANGLING, Tier-2a), not by shape.

node.description: Container-xor-leaf (inv 2): each branch enumerates its full field set with additionalProperties:false, so a node carrying both children and body_atoms fails both branches.

children.description: Ordered child node_ids = reading order (s4_plan §3.B.6). May be empty at Tier-1; the empty-container rejection is Tier-2 (EMPTY_CONTAINER, inv 26).

body_atoms.description: Owned body atom ids, strictly ascending by canonical-stream index, non-contiguous permitted (s4_plan §3.B.6); ordering is Tier-2 (BODY_ATOMS_UNORDERED, inv 27).

node_id.description: Opaque, persisted, never recomputed (D33); unique within the map (Tier-2a, DUPLICATE_NODE_ID); never derived from designation/title/position/content (NODE_ID_DERIVED).

node_class.description: Open per-book vocabulary declared in block_vocabulary — deliberately NO enum here (inv 22): the schema carries no book's block names.

minted_by.description: The conceptual minting authority (s4_plan §3.C.2) — a human mints a container, the extractor machine-mints a leaf; not the runtime writer. The split is enforced both ways at Tier-2 (MINTED_BY_SPLIT, inv 7).

decision.description: Reserved decision-provenance enum (s4_plan §1.4.1): present but INERT in S4 — no S4 code reads it (inv 25); value-semantics are S8.2.

rebind_anchors.description: Optional re-bind checkpoint sub-object (D-S4-H, inv 13/24). The only admitted key is region — a present/geom key is rejected by additionalProperties:false (node-level anchors are never the atom-level Geom). Population is S5.1. Coordinate contract (s4_plan §0.3 A-3, BR-022): region's page and bbox_region are expressed in the same coordinate space as the atom-level Geom the S2.1 matcher emits — one space shared with atom geometry, never a second convention — so a stored region is directly comparable to an atom's box at re-bind time. The concrete space (and any witness/space discriminator field) is an S5-planning decision; widening this shape is a schema-version bump that re-enters provisional and re-runs the birth gate.

manifest.description: The lineage manifest (s4_plan §3.E): per-layer versions + stale classes, the two split canonical hashes, and the ResourceLineage fragment. S4 stamps this basis; the stored-vs-live stale COMPARISON is S8.1's (§1.3.2). Structural completeness (the required set here) is the only S4 manifest rejection (inv 11).

source_artifacts.description: Raw witness source hashes (the AtomStream source_hash anchors).

atom_streams.description: Per-stream content hashes (canonical envelope form, lineage producers — D-S4-I).

canonical_content_hash.description: lineage._sha256_bytes over lineage._canonical of the canonical-stream-ordered {atom_id, text, raw_span, raw_source_hash} payloads (s4_plan §3.E.1).

canonical_geometry_hash.description: The geometry sibling of canonical_content_hash, over the geom-region fields (s4_plan §3.E.1) — split so a geometry re-match does not masquerade as a content change.

layers.description: The three persisted layers, each independently versioned with its own stale class (M3). relation_store is pinned present:false until S7.1c.

handle_renderer_version.description: Stamped for S8.1 to compare (s4_plan §3.D.6); bumped on slug/disambiguation-rule changes. No mismatch routing in S4.

resource_lineage.description: The ResourceLineage.to_json() fragment, embedded verbatim (s4_plan §3.E.3) — its shape is pinned here so a lineage.py shape change fails the §4.3 contract test.

descriptor.description: The parsed canonical descriptor — its internal shape is the lineage's own (resource vs normalizer), deliberately open here.
